tasks.name: 创建博客模型
tasks.description: 创建 BlogPost 模型用于存储博客信息。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog_post.py，包含字段: id, title, content, image_url, created_at。

tasks.name: 创建博客API
tasks.description: 创建博客的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blog_posts.py，包含创建博客、获取博客列表、更新博客和删除博客的接口。支持上传图片并保存其 URL。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 实现图片上传功能。在 app/utils/ 下创建 image_upload.py，处理图片上传逻辑，包括文件验证和存储路径生成。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 创建博客管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blog.html，包含博客创建表单（标题、内容、图片上传）和博客列表展示。

tasks.name: 设置静态文件支持
tasks.description: 配置静态文件支持以存储和访问上传的图片。在项目的 settings 或配置文件中添加静态文件路径，并确保前端可以正确加载图片。

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Blog model with fields like title, content, author, and timestamp using an ORM such as Django ORM or SQLAlchemy.
T1.notes: Ensure proper field validation and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Create RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the Blog model using a framework like Django REST Framework or Flask.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and pagination for secure and scalable access.

T3.implementation_approach: Use a library like Django's FileField or Flask-Uploads to handle image uploads and store them in a media directory or cloud storage.
T3.notes: Validate file types and sizes to ensure security and performance.

T4.implementation_approach: Develop a responsive frontend using a framework like React or Vue.js to display blog posts and allow user interactions.
T4.notes: Integrate the frontend with the API for dynamic content fetching.

T5.implementation_approach: Configure the web server or framework to serve static files like CSS, JS, and images, using settings like Django's STATICFILES_DIRS or Flask's static folder.
T5.notes: Ensure proper caching and compression for better performance.

Create a new blog post, including an optional image upload.
Update an existing blog post by ID.
Delete a blog post by ID.

frontend_routes./: Homepage displaying the list of blog posts.
